title: Better Than Takeaway Sweet & Sour Pork
description: Golden, crispy pork with a sticky, tangy sauce — exactly what you want when you skip the takeaway.

ingredients.item: Seasonings of choice (salt, garlic powder, Chinese five-spice)
Other veggies of choice (carrot, pineapple chunks, etc.)

method.instruction: In a bowl, marinate pork pieces with soy sauce, white pepper, and your choice of seasonings. Let sit for 15-20 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine plain flour and cornflour. Beat the egg in another small bowl.
Dip each marinated pork piece in the beaten egg, then coat thoroughly in the flour mixture.
Heat oil in a wok or deep pan to 170-180°C. Deep fry the pork pieces in batches until golden and crispy, about 5-6 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels.
For the sauce: In a small bowl, mix together ketchup, brown sugar, and white vinegar. Set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat. Stir-fry onion and capsicum for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp.
Add garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add any additional vegetables (carrots, pineapple) and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the sweet and sour sauce mixture. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the crispy pork pieces and toss quickly to coat in the sauce. Don't let them sit too long or they'll lose their crispiness.

notes.title: Keep It Crispy
notes.content: Add the pork to the sauce at the very last moment and serve immediately. The longer it sits in the sauce, the softer the coating becomes.

notes.title: Double Fry
notes.content: For extra crispy pork, fry once at 160°C, let rest 5 minutes, then fry again at 180°C until golden.

notes.title: Add Pineapple
notes.content: Fresh or canned pineapple chunks add authentic sweetness and texture. Add them with the vegetables.
